extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF text and figure locators; the prior automated protein-synthesis/nucleic-acid locator notes were rejected as scaffold artifacts.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aureobasidin A and Compound 20 did not show source-supported inhibition of the Toxoplasma IPC synthase orthologue TgSLS in the yeast complementation/susceptibility assay; TgSLS-complemented yeast were resistant at the tested concentrations while the yeast AUR1 control remained sensitive.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is negative mechanism evidence, not a positive target assignment; no alternative molecular target is established.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aureobasidin A and Compound 20 did not alter the complex sphingolipid profile synthesized by isolated Toxoplasma tachyzoites under the tested 10 ug/mL exposure conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Aureobasidin A and Compound 20 in isolated Toxoplasma tachyzoites
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay rules out the paper's tested sphingolipid-biosynthesis hypothesis under these conditions but does not identify the cidal target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AbA shows rapid direct activity against isolated tachyzoites, while Compound 20 activity is more reversible; the paper leaves the molecular mode of action unresolved.
direct_assay_types: tachyzoite pretreatment and washout proliferation assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is phenotype-level cidal/reversibility evidence and must not be promoted to a named molecular mechanism.
